integrity: Analytic theorem with a reproducible supplementary numerical checker; underlying impulse-response coefficients and continuum fourth-order kernel are previously known; no claim of exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous nearest-neighbor integer lattice and periodic quotient only; the strong-smoothing infinite-lattice gain and two iterated limits, not a two-parameter uniform expansion, arbitrary boundary conditions, or every finite-strength norm.
title: Universal endpoint amplification in lattice biharmonic smoothing and noncommuting cycle limits
